en manah kovilin.why: the recording sings 'en manak-kovilin vadil' (Whisper, Tamil): the title's 'Kovililin' is a typo of this song's name

chodi de manthi.why: the recording (Gujarati Bhajans Vol.1) sings 'chodi de manthi dukh ni chinta', the printed first line of this song (vol5-47)

chod de manase (odiya version).why: the recording sings the Gujarati 'chodi de manthi' (vol5-47), not the Odiya version

ardiente es el llanto (spanish).why: the recording sings the refrain 'amor infinito'; the printed song (2025-59) has 'gotitas de amor infinito'; the album retitled the first word

isar tumi.why: the recording sings 'ise tumi daya kare ... jag ko re jane wala tu' (Whisper, Hindi); the printed first line (vol5-66) is 'Isar tumi daya karo'

unnum sorum.why: the recording sings (Whisper, Tamil, 150 s) 'unnam sorum parukum nirum ... yaru tantatu namakku yaru tantatu ... adiyanta ... illa annai tantatu amrtamana anandamayi annai tantatu', the sheet's first four lines (UnnumSorum)

dasarathe raghuramana (kannada).why: the recording sings (Whisper, 90 s) 'ramana nenedare, chira suga sambhava ... dosharahita ... ramana nenedare', the sheet's lines 'raghuramana nenedare ... dosharahita sri ramana nenedare, chira sukha sampada dorakuvudu' (DasaratheRaghuramana)

vadikorinetra.why: the recording sings (Whisper, Tamil script, 30 s) 'vadil puritarikkum ... madiyunarttuvar vindum talirttuvan naleykku nirajanotsavam', the sheet's lines 'vadiyil koritarikyunna pukkale, madiyunarttuvan vindum talirtta pu chuduvan naley kyu nirajanotsava' (Vadikorinetra)

sri raghavam.why: the recording opens (Whisper, Hindi, 0-60 s) with 'sri ra..rathatmajam aprame.. ..kulanvaya ratna dipam', 'ajanubahum aravinda dalayatakshamm', 'ramam nisacara vinasakaram namami', the sheet's four lines (SriRaghavam); Raghupati Raghava follows at 90 s as a medley

yatha yariyiykkan.why: vol3-259 prints the heading 'Yatha yariyiykkan' and the first line 'Vyatha yariyiykkan vazhi yariyativan'; the recording is titled with the first line's word; the sheet VyathaAriyikkan links to this entry

nencakaë ventitunnu (malayalam).why: the index name's final 'ë' is the font-map transcription artefact seen in the other renamed names (ṭ→l, ä→r); read as 'nencakam ventitunnu' the recording's title is identical word for word; the entry is printed in no book we have, so no lyrics exist to read, and the audio was unintelligible in nine windows

amma amma amma.why: Whisper hears Devanagari 'amma amma amma' and the Hindi line 'dur karo sab sankat tere' (round 6, box-audio-sample-6.md); the album is Hindi Bhajans Vol.2. The Tamil twin 'amma amma amma (tamil, amit)' shares the title and stays unlinked.

jaya jagadisvari (marathi).why: Whisper hears 'jaya jagadishwari jaya param(e)shwari de(i) sukha ...', the Marathi entry's first line (2019supl-38); the Hindi 'jai jagadisvari' prints 'jay jagadisvari mata sarasvati' (vol4-68).

jai jagadisvari.why: sings the Marathi 'jaya jagadisvari jaya paramesvari', see 'jaya jagadisvari (marathi)'

nandalala nandalala (sanskrit).why: Whisper hears 'hari nanda lala nava jaladhara samani(la) ...', this entry's first line (vol6-159, sheet NandalalaNandalalaHari); the Hindi 'nanda lala nanda lala' prints 'nanda lala prabhu radha lola gopi lola'.

nanda lala nanda lala.why: sings the Sanskrit 'nanda lala hari nanda lala nava jaladhara', see 'nandalala nandalala (sanskrit)'

ananda vithiyiludente.why: Whisper (Tamil script) hears 'ananda vithi(yi)ludente atmavu adi rasichu nadannu ...', the printed first line (vol4-27); the title rule stops at 'veedhi' being the first letters of 'vithiyiludente'.

krsna govinda gopala (hindi).why: Whisper hears 'sri krishna govinda murali manohara gokula nandana gopala ... devaki nandana gopala' (round 6, box-audio-sample-6.md), the Hindi entry's lines (vol2-123); the Sanskrit 'sri krsna govinda gopala' sings 'krsna govinda gopala srila'.

sri krsna govinda gopala.why: sings the Hindi 'murali manohara gokula nandana gopala', see 'krsna govinda gopala (hindi)'

apara krpalo arikil.why: Whisper hears 'adi sharaa krishnam aram varao' ≈ 'avanisvara krsna arul varam tayo', this Malayalam sheet's line (round 6, box-audio-sample-6.md); the Kannada and Telugu entries carry plain tags (so the title alone decides nothing) and hold their own tagged recordings 'Apara Krpalo (Kannada)/(Telugu)'; the Amritanjali 'Classic' recording predates both versions.

manasa vacha karmana.why: Whisper hears 'manasa vacha karmana nirantaram ninne smari...' (as 'Manasavajah Kalmanah Kiren Kerem In Ismari' and 'anas ma-kha karminal Nirem'), this Malayalam sheet's first line (round 7, box-audio-sample-7.md); the Kannada 'manasavaca karmana (kannada)' and the Marathi version share the opening words.

manasavaca karmana (kannada).why: sing the Malayalam 'manasa vacha karmana nirantaram', see 'manasa vacha karmana'
